tickets.title: CSV import: file upload step with 10MB limit
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Admin can upload .csv up to 10MB from Settings > Members > Import. 2. Non-CSV files rejected with inline error 'Only .csv files are supported'. 3. Upload over 10MB rejected client-side before request is sent. 4. Successful upload advances to the mapping step.

tickets.title: CSV import: column mapping UI
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Auto-map columns whose header matches a Relay field name (case-insensitive). 2. Unmapped required fields (email, role) block the Continue button with message 'Map all required fields to continue'. 3. Mapping choices persist if the admin goes back to the upload step.

comments.author: Tomás Rivera
comments.body: Design reviewed with Lena, matches Figma v2. Good to go.

tickets.title: CSV import: post-import summary email
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Email sent to the importing admin within 5 minutes of import completion. 2. Email lists rows imported, rows skipped, and a link to the skipped-rows report. 3. Uses the existing transactional template (no new template work).

tickets.title: CSV import: dedupe against existing members by email
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Rows whose email matches an existing active member are skipped and counted in the summary. 2. Rows matching a deactivated member prompt 'Reactivate 12 deactivated members?' with confirm/skip. 3. Matching is case-insensitive on email.

comments.body: Can't start until the email-index migration (CORE-1790) lands — matching queries time out on large workspaces without it.

tickets.title: CSV import: audit-log entries for import events
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. One audit-log entry per import: actor, timestamp, filename, rows imported/skipped. 2. Entry visible in Settings > Audit Log within 1 minute. 3. Entries are immutable.

tickets.title: Import error page: empty-file and encoding edge cases
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Empty file shows 'This file has no rows to import'. 2. Non-UTF-8 files are detected and shown 'Unsupported encoding — save the file as UTF-8 and retry'. 3. Both states are recoverable without restarting the flow.

comments.author: Sam Whitfield
comments.body: Open question: do we detect UTF-16 specifically or just reject anything non-UTF-8? Support says Excel-on-Windows exports UTF-16 constantly. Needs a decision before we build.

tickets.title: Rate-limit import jobs per workspace
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Max 3 concurrent import jobs per workspace; 4th attempt queues with banner 'Import queued — 2 ahead of you'. 2. Queued jobs start automatically in order. 3. Limit configurable via server flag, default 3.

tickets.title: Fix: member list pagination skips page 2 after role filter
tickets.acceptance_criteria: 1. Applying a role filter then paging shows pages 1..N with no skips. 2. Regression test covers filter + paginate combination.
